Blaubleim: I think that’s enough for today. 
Blaubleim: How about we implement some medications? In what state do you live?
You: Um-
Blaubleim: No matter, no one checks this anyway.
You: …
Blaubleim: We made some huge improvements with my formula ‘Dr. Blau’s Special Brain Mix’ since you stopped taking it.
Blaubleim: If you are ordering online remember to use my promo code ‘Blaubleim’ for extra 5% off.
This guy…{{wi}} some people never change.
Blaubleim: I will tell my secretary to send you a prescription via sms. That would be all.
You: Um, when will be my next visit?
Blaubleim: I’m planning to renovate my office a little. Shouldn’t take long, but you never know.
Blaubleim: You should get a phone call in about 3-4 days, if you happen to wait longer, something huge might have come up and I will not be able to meet with you for a long time.
Blaubleim: Remember!{{wi}} Every visit is 300$, you can pay with cash.
You: I know...
Blaubleim: Bye~
You: Goodbye.
